Sui Daye ninth year fifth month dingchou, Mars retrograde entering Southern Dipper, color red as blood, large as a three-dou vessel, light shaking bright, seven or eight chi long, moving hooked within the Dipper—also a celestial change never before seen. Afterward Yang Xuangan rebelled, great disorder under heaven.
124
故五星留逆伏見之効，表裏盈縮之行，皆係之於時，而象之於政。 政小失則小變，事微而象微，事章而象章。 已示吉凶之象，則又變行，襲其常度。 不然，則皇天何以陰騭下民，警悟人主哉！
Therefore the five planets' stationary, retrograde, hidden, and visible effects, inner and outer expansion and contraction motion—all depend on the times and image government. Small governmental fault brings small change; slight affairs bring slight images, manifest affairs bring manifest images. Having shown auspicious and inauspicious images, they then change motion, resuming their regular degrees. Otherwise, how would august heaven secretly assist the people below and warn and awaken the human lord!
125
近代算者昧於象，占者迷於數，覩五星失行，皆謂之曆舛。 雖七曜循軌，猶或謂之天災。 終以數象相蒙，兩喪其實。 故較曆必稽古今注記，入氣均而行度齊，上下相距，反復相求。 苟獨異於常，則失行可知矣。
Recent calculators are blind to images; omen-readers are lost in numbers—seeing five planets' aberrant motion, all call it calendar error. Though the seven luminaries follow their tracks, some still call it heavenly calamity. In the end numbers and images mutually obscure, both losing the reality. Therefore comparing calendars must consult ancient and modern annotation records—entering qi evenly and motion degrees aligned, distances above and below, seeking back and forth repeatedly. If alone differing from regularity, aberrant motion can be known.
126
凡二星相近，多為之失行。 三星以上，失度彌甚。 天竺曆以九執之情，皆有所好惡。 遇其所好之星，則趣之行疾，捨之行遲。
Whenever two stars are near each other, they mostly cause aberrant motion for each other. Three stars or more—the deviation in degrees is ever greater. The Indian calendar by the Nine Holders' dispositions—all have likes and dislikes. Meeting a star they favor, they hasten in motion; leaving, motion slows.
127
張子信曆辰星應見不見術，晨夕去日前後四十六度內，十八度外，有木、火、土、金一星者見，無則不見。 張冑玄曆，朔望在交限，有星伏在日下，木、土去見十日外，火去見四十日外，金去見二十二日外者，並不加減差，皆精氣相感使然。
Zhang Zixin's calendar Mercury should-appear-but-not method: within 46 degrees before and after the sun at dawn and dusk, within 18 degrees outside, if Wood, Fire, Earth, or Metal star is present it appears; if not, it does not appear. Zhang Zengxuan's calendar: at new and full moon within conjunction limits, stars hidden beneath the sun; Wood and Earth ten days outside appearance, Fire forty days outside, Metal twenty-two days outside—all without adding or subtracting difference, all because essential qi mutually responds.
128
夫日月所以著尊卑不易之象，五星所以示政教從時之義。 故日月之失行也，微而少； 五星之失行也，著而多。 今略考常數，以課疎密。
Sun and moon therefore display the image of rank unchanging; five planets therefore show the meaning of government and teaching following the times. Therefore sun and moon's aberrant motion is subtle and few; five planets' aberrant motion is manifest and many. Now briefly examining regular numbers to assess density and looseness.
129
略例曰：其入氣加減，亦自張子信始，後人莫不遵用之。 原始要終，多有不叶。 今較麟德曆，熒惑、太白見伏行度過與不及，熒惑凡四十八事，太白二十一事。 餘星所差，蓋細不足考。 且盈縮之行，宜與四象潛合，而二十四氣加減不均。 更推易數而正之，又各立歲差，以究五精運周二十八舍之變。 較史官所記，歲星二十七事，熒惑二十八事，鎮星二十一事，太白二十二事，辰星二十四事，開元曆課皆第一云。
The summary says: Entering qi increase and decrease also began with Zhang Zixin—later people all followed and used it. Origin and end, beginning and finish—many do not agree. Now comparing the Linde calendar, Mars and Venus appearance, hiding, and motion degrees exceeding and falling short—Mars 48 cases in all, Venus 21 cases. Other stars' discrepancies are too fine to examine. Moreover expansion and contraction motion should secretly agree with the four images, yet twenty-four qi increase and decrease are uneven. Further deriving Changes numbers to correct it, also each establishing annual difference, to investigate the five essences' circuit through twenty-eight lodges' changes. Comparing historiographers' records—Jupiter 27 cases, Mars 28, Saturn 21, Venus 22, Mercury 24—the Kaiyuan calendar's assessments all rank first.
130
至肅宗時，山人韓穎上言大衍曆或誤。 帝疑之，以穎為太子宮門郎，直司天臺。 又損益其術，每節增二日，更名至德曆，起乾元元年用之，訖上元三年。
At Emperor Suzong's time, the mountain man Han Ying memorialized that the Dayan calendar sometimes erred. The emperor doubted it, appointing Ying as Crown Prince Palace Gate Gentleman, stationed at the Directorate of Astronomy. He also adjusted their methods, adding two days per node, renaming it the Zhide calendar, starting Qianyuan first year for use, ending Shangyuan third year.
131
